package com.example.library;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Keeps track of which member has borrowed which book.
 *
 * <p>Fixture for the token estimator tests: conventional Java with
 * generics, streams, records, checked exceptions and Javadoc.
 */
public final class LoanService {

    private static final int MAX_LOANS_PER_MEMBER = 5;
    private static final Duration LOAN_PERIOD = Duration.ofDays(21);

    public record Loan(String isbn, String memberId, LocalDate borrowedOn, LocalDate dueOn) {
        public boolean isOverdue(LocalDate today) {
            return today.isAfter(dueOn);
        }
    }

    public static class LoanLimitExceededException extends Exception {
        public LoanLimitExceededException(String memberId, int limit) {
            super("Member " + memberId + " already has " + limit + " books on loan");
        }
    }

    private final Map<String, Loan> loansByIsbn = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final BookCatalog catalog;

    public LoanService(BookCatalog catalog) {
        this.catalog = Objects.requireNonNull(catalog, "catalog must not be null");
    }

    /**
     * Lends a book to a member.
     *
     * @param isbn     the book to lend
     * @param memberId the borrowing member
     * @param today    the current date, injected to keep the method testable
     * @return the created loan
     * @throws LoanLimitExceededException if the member has too many books
     * @throws IllegalStateException      if the book is unknown or already on loan
     */
    public Loan lend(String isbn, String memberId, LocalDate today) throws LoanLimitExceededException {
        if (!catalog.contains(isbn)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown book: " + isbn);
        }
        long current = loansByIsbn.values().stream()
                .filter(loan -> loan.memberId().equals(memberId))
                .count();
        if (current >= MAX_LOANS_PER_MEMBER) {
            throw new LoanLimitExceededException(memberId, MAX_LOANS_PER_MEMBER);
        }
        Loan loan = new Loan(isbn, memberId, today, today.plusDays(LOAN_PERIOD.toDays()));
        Loan previous = loansByIsbn.putIfAbsent(isbn, loan);
        if (previous != null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Book " + isbn + " is already on loan until " + previous.dueOn());
        }
        return loan;
    }

    public Optional<Loan> giveBack(String isbn) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(loansByIsbn.remove(isbn));
    }

    public List<Loan> overdue(LocalDate today) {
        List<Loan> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Loan loan : loansByIsbn.values()) {
            if (loan.isOverdue(today)) {
                result.add(loan);
            }
        }
        result.sort(Comparator.comparing(Loan::dueOn).thenComparing(Loan::isbn));
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(result);
    }

    public Map<String, Long> loansPerMember() {
        return loansByIsbn.values().stream()
                .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Loan::memberId, Collectors.counting()));
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "LoanService{activeLoans=" + loansByIsbn.size() + '}';
    }

    /** Minimal view of the catalogue that this service depends on. */
    public interface BookCatalog {
        boolean contains(String isbn);
    }
}
